workflow_purpose: Demonstrate bounded independent scientific assurance on synthetic IV-bolus PK

claimed_conclusions.text: Predicted concentrations match one-compartment IV bolus decay under stated parameters.
for all t in Time, concentration >= 0

computational_assertions.statement: CSV rows match C(t)=(dose/V)*exp(-(CL/V)*t) within tolerance

assumptions.text: One-compartment linear kinetics with constant CL and V

verification_boundaries: No claim of biological or clinical validity
publication_permissions: synthetic fixtures may be published with the repository
unresolved_questions: Would an independent laboratory accept this workflow on real PK data?
What institutional approvals are required for non-synthetic pilots?
